correctness.rationale: Substitution into the bilinear Rota–Baxter identity yields r_i²=(2r_i+1)r_j on each nonzero edge; strong connectivity propagates zero support. On full support u_i=1+1/r_i conjugates the edge map to u_j=u_i². Closed-walk cycle-length gcd d yields u^(2^d-1)=1, and path-length congruence constructs all well-defined operators without dividing by two, even in characteristic two. Constant u=0 gives -id; the finite-field count uses cyclic F_q^×. Independent direct F7 edge-equation sweeps match 3-cycle, reverse-edge and period-two branching cases.

value.rationale: The arithmetic graph-period invariant gives exact operator counts under arbitrary branching and nonzero structure coefficients; a single added reverse edge can collapse the whole family, and perfect nonmonomial examples show this is not merely a cyclic renaming. This is a motivated structural extension.

final_claim: For a strongly connected evolution-algebra structure digraph of period d, all diagonal weight-one operators over any field are zero, minus identity, and parameters u!=1 with u^(2^d-1)=1; over F_q the count is 1+gcd(2^d-1,q-1).
